' እያሉ ሲደወልባቸው ወይም ከሶሻል ሚዲያ ሲሰሙ ፤ የሚፈጠረውን ነገር አስቡት። አንዳንዴ ቆይ እንዲህ አይነት ነገር ከሆነ በቃ መረጋጋት፣ ከዛ ከቤተሰብ ይመጣል፣ ' ሰምተዋል ፣ ተረድተዋል ፣ አሁን ቢነገር ችግር የለውም ' ሲባል ብቻ መናገር ቢቻል እንደው ጥንቃቄ ብናደርግ። " 👉 ከድምጻዊ ሚኪያስ ቸርነት ህልፈት ጋር በተያያዘ ቤተሰብ ሳይሰማ በሶሻል ሚዲያ ላይ መርዶ ለማርዳት የታየው ሩጫ አንድ ትልቅ ነገር ሊያስተምረን ይገባል፤ የሰው ሕይወት ማለፍ እና የቤተሰብ መሪር ሐዘን የቪው እና የተከታይ ማግኛ መወዳደሪያ መሆን የለበትም። ለተከታይ ብዛት ሲባል የሰብዓዊነት እና የመርዶ ባህላችንን መስመር አንለፍ! ነፍስ ይማር ! ቲክቫህ ኢትዮጵያ ህዳር 12 ቀን 2019 ዓ/ም @tikvahethiopia

Nuno Felix RT @IlvesToomas : Not all techies are obnoxious broligarchs and masters of the universe. Some actually want to ensure AI is safe. Europe needs more people like Jaan. One of the most remarkable investment stories in the technology sector comes from #Estonia. In 2021, Jaan Tallinn, co-founder of Skype, became one of the earliest investors in Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude. According to Forbes, Tallinn invested an estimated $60 million across Anthropic's first two funding rounds in 2021 and 2022. Fast forward to November 2026. Following #Anthropic's historic IPO, Forbes estimated the value of his approximately 1.15% stake at $18.3 billion - a 305-fold return on his original investment. His estimated total net worth reached $19.7 billion. But what makes this story particularly interesting is that Tallinn's original motivation was not primarily financial. For more than a decade, he has been one of the leading advocates for AI safety, investing in research and organisations addressing the potential risks of advanced artificial intelligence. His decision to invest in Anthropic was partly motivated by a desire to influence how such powerful technology is developed. As an Estonian, and knowing how great Jaan really is, it is difficult not to feel proud. And perhaps the most interesting part of this story is that it was never just about money. - Jaanika Merilo tweet
